items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
4-7 years of related experience.

Applies technical expertise and business analysis concepts to identify, evaluate and define complex systems scope and objectives with an understanding of applicable business practices, processes, systems and industry standards to meet end-user needs. Creates and documents technical specifications to meet user needs within the department, including developing and implementing complex CRM-user interface designs. Conduct on-going analysis of business processes, make recommendations and deliver solutions that align with the overall department roadmap. Proactively gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes recommendations of process and procedural documentation, implementing approved changes. (25% time)

Supports development of on-going and new drip email campaigns, specifically updating the template to be used and ensuring the logic is accurate. Assists in executing communications emails using new or existing templates, specifically ensuring targets are accurate. Builds and checks queries (quality assurance) for mid to high risk communications involving student business processes. (20% time)

Provides technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing complex systems and procedures. Creates complex specifications for systems to mee tend-user requirements. Involved in developing complex user interface designs. Plans and executes unit integration and acceptance testing. Participates in cross-functional teams to address complex business or systems issues. Works as part of a larger team on one-off and regularly occurring technical projects within the CRM tool and other university systems. Participates in cross-functional teams to address complex business or systems issues as the owner of technical aspects of the platform. Interacts with department leadership to align business needs with CRM technical solutions. (15% time)
Manage data uploads while maintaining data integrity, create or update eventsforms, and even portals within Slate CRM while providing documentation andtraining as needed. (15% time)

Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes business and user needs, documenting requirements and revising existing system and process logic issues as necessary. Provides support and training on new applications. Guides and advises less-experienced Business Systems Analysts. Provides support and training on new CRM features to users with varying backgrounds and experiences. Consults with department leadership about how staff may better use applications that are currently available to them. Plans and executes unit integration and acceptance testing for Slate. (15% time)
Performs other functions as needed. (5% time)

Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes recommendations for approval of business process and procedural documentation. Recommends and implements changes in processes and procedures. Negotiates with stake holders on the creation of specifications. Monitors and evaluates how staff use the CRM tool to determine how it can be used more effectively to meet business needs. Analyzes, prepares and summarizes business and user needs, documenting requirements and developing reports that outline shortfalls and problems with the current use of the system. Educate staff about system functions to navigate expectations relative to capabilities. (5% time)

Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines. Demonstrates problem solving skills.
Thorough knowledge of related areas of IT.
Thorough knowledge of business and process analysis functions.
Broad knowledge relating to software design.

Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization. Interpersonal and communications skills to work with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Strong skills and knowledge of methodologies associated with analysis of processes and problems, information flow and architecture.
Demonstrated ability to work with others from diverse backgrounds.
In-depth understanding and skill in process and systems requirement documentation standards, such as Use Case modeling, User Story creations and narrative description.
Thorough knowledge of business processes and procedures.
Demonstrated testing and test planning skills.
